tokenAcquisition: Internal to sqlcmd and its SDK; no custom token request or AccessToken injection
sql:
SET NOCOUNT ON;
SELECT ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS originalLogin, USER_NAME() AS userName, DB_NAME() AS databaseName,
 JSON_QUERY((SELECT id, marker FROM dbo.AuthProbe WHERE id=1 FOR JSON PATH)) AS markerRows,
 JSON_QUERY((SELECT
 HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(N'dbo.AuthProbe',N'OBJECT',N'SELECT') AS canSelect,
 HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(N'dbo.AuthProbe',N'OBJECT',N'INSERT') AS canInsert,
 HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(N'dbo.AuthProbe',N'OBJECT',N'UPDATE') AS canUpdate,
 HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(N'dbo.AuthProbe',N'OBJECT',N'DELETE') AS canDelete,
 IS_ROLEMEMBER(N'db_owner') AS dbOwner,
 IS_ROLEMEMBER(N'db_datareader') AS dbDataReader
 FOR JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER)) AS permissions
FOR JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER;

externalIdentityVerification.scope: SQL identity and isolated environment; not a fresh JWT claims capture
